summary: Lemmy is a self-hosted fediverse link-aggregator and comment forum (ActivityPub). It persists users, communities, posts, comments, private messages, votes/saves/read-state, reports, moderation logs, notifications, site/local-site config, instances, images and federation state in PostgreSQL via Diesel; the API exposes ~190 CRUD/action endpoints under /api/v4.
